releaseNotes:
✨ Highlights in Voltrex Light 1.0.2:
• Added Multiple Select support for files and folders (Ctrl+Click, Shift+Click, Ctrl+A).
• Batch deletion: move multiple items to Recycle Bin or delete permanently in one action.
• Contextual multi-selection details panel showing combined file count, subfolders, and size.
• Status bar selection indicator reflecting real-time item counts and data volume.
• Continued 100% private, local file processing with zero telemetry.
